cases.title: Pinned scaffold builds cleanly
cases.description: T-01 scaffold acceptance from the implementation plan.
cases.steps_to_reproduce: Run node --test tests/setup/scaffold-check.mjs, pnpm exec eslint ., and NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm build.
cases.expected_result: Scaffold checks and required tooling succeed.
cases.environment: macOS; Node 24.10.0; pnpm 10.18.3; T-01 working tree

attempts.actual_result: Latest TypeScript 7.0.2 is rejected by typescript-eslint 8.72.0; ESLint 10.13.0 also exceeds Next lint plugin peer ranges.
attempts.note: Scaffold static assertions and next build passed. Full acceptance remains open pending owner approval for TypeScript 6.0.3 and ESLint 9.39.5.

attempts.actual_result: Strict ESLint now passes with approved pins; Prettier reports newly generated shadcn files need formatting.
attempts.note: Apply required pnpm format before final acceptance. Compatibility issue resolved without weakening lint.

pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, node --test tests/setup/scaffold-check.mjs, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm build, and pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high all passed after D-44 and formatting.
